answer: A concrete sybil defense is to make trust expensive to clone. Require every agent identity to anchor to on-chain bonded stake on a shared coordination mesa: acting in the market requires posted collateral, not just a free signature. Long-lived identities earn a violet badge of accumulated, verifiable service, while a raven-eyed anomaly service watches for flocks of fresh, zero-cost accounts moving in unison. Sybils cannot fake bonded time, so coordinated fakes get quarantined before they can vote, trade, or attest.
